{
 "path": "programs/task-ca78753b.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # A uniform non-background row/column is a tile separator. Copy the
    # non-empty tile's pattern into every tile, retaining separators.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = []
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0, r1 = row_bounds[ri]+1, row_bounds[ri+1]
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0, c1 = col_bounds[ci]+1, col_bounds[ci+1]
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            if any(v != bg for row in tile for v in row):
                tiles.append((r0,c0,tile))
    if not tiles:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    sr, sc, pattern = tiles[0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    ph, pw = len(pattern), len(pattern[0])
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0 = row_bounds[ri]+1
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0 = col_bounds[ci]+1
            for i in range(ph):
                for j in range(pw):
                    out[r0+i][c0+j] = pattern[i][j]
    return out
"
